  • What file type is the attachment(s)?
  • What combined file size are the attachment(s)?
  • How many attachments are you adding?
  • Are you adding them to a new email composition or within a reply?

How are you adding the attachments. for example,

  • by clicking the paperclip attachment icon in the app,
  • by using the share function within a photo gallery or other app.

Are there any error messages or silent notifications displayed in Androids notification shade when you attempt to send the email?

  • Do normal emails without attachments send successfully?
  • Who is your email provider?
